baseline_ohlcv_signal.description: OHLCV-based predictive effects not robust across original research chain

isolated_cross_sectional_context.description: Cross-sectional context did not produce convincing robust improvements
isolated_cross_sectional_context.lesson: Cross-sectional features need interaction with other signals

unstable_macro_effects.description: Macro-regime hypothesis showed temporal instability and regime dependence
unstable_macro_effects.lesson: Macro effects are regime-dependent, not consistently positive

weak_portfolio_translation.description: No candidate produced economically robust portfolio performance
weak_portfolio_translation.lesson: IC does not automatically translate to portfolio economics

model_family_disagreement.description: Results sensitive to model family choice (Ridge vs Lasso)
model_family_disagreement.lesson: Linear model dependence is a limitation

macro_equity_interaction.description: Macro variables may interact with equity prediction at longer horizons
macro_equity_interaction.evidence: HYP-MAC showed monotonic improvement from H-5 to H-20

horizon_mismatch.description: Different signals may have different optimal horizons
horizon_mismatch.evidence: HYP-MOM stable across horizons, HYP-VOL drops at longer horizons

regime_dependence.description: Some effects may only exist in specific market regimes

linear_representation_limitation.description: Linear models may miss non-linear interactions

genuine_oos_confirmation.description: No genuinely untouched holdout data exists for any hypothesis

non_linear_model_performance.description: Unknown whether non-linear models reveal different patterns

feature_space_expansion.description: Unknown whether alternative data provides additional predictive power

portfolio_economics.description: Unknown whether IC levels translate to meaningful portfolio returns

data_snooping_quantification.description: Unknown how much observed IC reflects selection bias

simple_ohlcv_only.description: Repeating OHLCV-only experiments adds little value

single_horizon_testing.description: Testing only H-5 adds little value given existing evidence
